text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Grass Wonder may have come out on top,
but your performance was
still incredible,
Spe.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
What are your thoughts on the Prix de
l'Arc de Triomphe? You
certainly have a
chance, but...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I was in tip-top shape and practiced lots and lots... I really, truly gave my all in that race.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
But Grass still passed me. No matter how
hard I ran, I couldn't get the
lead back.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
After that race, it's crystal clear... I
wouldn't win the Arc even if I did
enter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Up until now, Special Week's dream of
being the best in Japan was a
vague
one—more of an idea than a goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But with the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe in
sight, she thought her dream was finally
taking form...
which makes this loss all the
harder.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
All right...
We'll put the Arc aside for now
and focus on domestic
races instead.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But I would still watch this year's race.
Just
because you're not ready
now doesn't
mean you'll never be.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But I would still watch this year's race.
Just
because you're not ready
now doesn't
mean you'll never be.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Huff... Huff...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Leeet's gooo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Huff... puff... Phew!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Riiing! Riiing! ♪

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Allo! Bonjour!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Hello, El. I'm not interrupting your
training, am I?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I was just about to take a break! I need
some grub, and fast!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Hehe, well,
I'm glad you've still got your
appetite."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Grass, good job at the Takarazuka Kinen!
That final stretch especially
was intense,
astonishing—downright amazing!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And sooo inspiring to watch! My
competitive spirit was setting my
whole
body on fire!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my, I'm honored to hear you feel that
way."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Watching you... Spe... all our friends
running so brilliantly—that is
what kept my
own dream alight in my heart.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
For that, I must repay all of you... And I
will. I shall make my dream
come true, and
stand above you all.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Sounds like you're as competitive
as ever!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You're also approaching your goal of
being the strongest, no?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Just three more months until the Arc. By
then, I'll be even faster than I
am now!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
And with that race... I'll show everyone
that I'm the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"It sounds like you'll have no problem
giving this race your all."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: My all, huh?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Guys! You have my gratitude,
appreciation—my deepest thanks for

seeing me off!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure you don't want us to go to
the airport with you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All bien! It's a weekday, right? Make sure
you learn lots and looots in
class!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry!
I'll study enough for both
of us, so use that energy to
give the
Japanese racing fans a real show!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Having a classmate taking on the world
will be something I share with
pride.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I await good news from overseas. And
don't you worry, I shall ensure
my
achievements reach you as well!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Well, I guess I... better go now...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I really... should get going...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, surely you don't have to leave right
now, do you?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... In that case,
to start your journey
off right...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Wh-what are you all doing?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Like I said,
we're setting the mood for your
journey. ♪ Watch out, if
you don't pay
attention, we'll pass you.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
A special send-off from all of us, eh?
Hehe, a splendid idea indeed!

text_block_list.name: Tsurumaru Tsuyoshi
text_block_list.text:
Here I gooo! I'm sending you off with all
I've got! Urrrraaaugh!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Count me in too! Draaaauuugh!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oho, what a motivated bunch.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hey, wait a sec! Are we racing for real?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff... El, it's your turn.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Show us the run of the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I am the Umamusume who will be the world's strongest! If you're gonna take me on...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You better be ready for a fight!
Yaaauuugh!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
You're right,
I left all my fears behind me
in Japan. I'm giving the Prix
de l'Arc de
Triomphe everything I have!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Good. I cannot wait to see you shining in
your full glory."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"And someday... I hope to race with the El
I see at the Prix de l'Arc de
Triomphe. ♪"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hehe, right!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
At long last, today's the day that Japan's
El Condor Pasa takes on the
top racers of
the world!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
In addition to viewers the world over, two
thousand of her fans are
here, hoping their
cheers will push her on.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa... Will she be the one to
make history—to go where
none of Japan's
racers have gone before and snatch the
gold?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
(This is it.
The race that will prove I'm the
world's strongest...)

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And now, the Umamusume on everyone's
minds enters the paddock!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Coming off six wins with only one
second-place race! France's
strongest,
Montjeu, steps onto the track!

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: ...Heh.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Montjeu...

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa... I've heard much about
you. Including how you've
traveled across
the globe to win this race.

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text:
I hope you will show me just what the
Umamusume of Japan are
capable of.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Don't you worry, I'll give you a race to
remember!

text_block_list.name: Montjeu
text_block_list.text: <May this race be our best.>

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The pinnacle of racing—the Prix de l'Arc
de Triomphe. My opponents include
top-class racers from all over the world,
including France's
strongest, Montjeu...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The players have stepped into the ring.
All that's left is to take them
on, show them
my strength, and emerge victorious... as
the world's strongest!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Will Japan's El Condor Pasa be able to
snatch victory from the world's
top racers,
including Montjeu?

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Leaving the paddock behind, our racers
ready themselves for the Prix
de l'Arc de
Triomphe!
